answer: The grove holds work receipts rather than names, so the voyage of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
